### **Job Description and Duties**


Do you aspire to work towards protecting our population and the environment from harmful chemicals? Then consider joining the Department of Toxic Substances Control (DTSC), Safer Consumer Products (SCP) Program. Our team is a dynamic, passionate, and diverse group of scientists, engineers, toxicologists, analysts, and administrative staff working to protect California's people and the environment by advancing the design, development, and use of chemically safer products. SCP is seeking an Environmental Scientist to help implement laws banning certain chemicals in consumer products, including developing regulations and conducting compliance and enforcement activities. This position is under the general direction of a Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisory). Learn more by visiting our homepage at https://www.dtsc.ca.gov/SCP/.  

**As an Environmental Scientist you will have the opportunity to:**
* Conduct technical research and data analysis to support the development of regulations, compliance sampling plans, and enforcement strategies, including identifying manufacturers and evaluating covered products to understand the scope of regulated products sold in California
* Assist with drafting rulemaking packages and preparing documentation to implement statutory and regulatory requirements in compliance with the Administrative Procedures Act
* Assist with pre\-regulatory workshops, public meetings, and external engagement activities, including outreach to manufacturers, retailers, and other interested parties
* Support the procurement and cataloging of samples for laboratory testing to carry out compliance sampling plans
* Analyze testing results and review documents submitted by responsible entities to assess compliance with chemical bans
* Provide technical assistance and compliance support to responsible entities, including manufacturers and retailers
* Help prepare public\-facing resources such as guidance documents, fact sheets, and website content to keep interested parties informed of compliance requirements and enforcement actions
* Assist with compliance and enforcement activities, including conducting investigations, preparing notices of violation, and developing documentation to support enforcement actions
* Draft reports to inform the Legislature, the public, department leadership, and agency management of compliance and enforcement updates

**Desirable Qualifications We Look For:**
* Ability to contribute to a team environment that values the diverse areas of experience and expertise of program staff
* Technical/Environmental Health writing \& editing experience
* Ability to identify a challenging problem and formulate and execute a solution
* Can complete long\-term projects
* Has ability to analyze and work with large volumes of data and information
* Ability to focus on maintaining professional, productive relationships with their peers, management, and external partners
* Knowledge of or experience with products, chemicals in products, or supply chains
* Strong communication skills, including editing, writing, and presenting
* Ability to maintain a well\-organized and flexible approach appropriate for working in a dynamic environment

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.

### **Job Description and Duties**


Are you interested in a meaningful and impactful career? Would you like to contribute to protecting people and the environment and accelerating a statewide transition to sustainable pest management? The Department of Pesticide Regulation (DPR) could be the place for you!
  

  

Under the direction of the Environmental Program Manager I (Supervisory), the Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist) acts as the scientific expert on the protection of surface water from pesticide contamination. The Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist) independently identifies problems, develops courses of action, and conducts complex scientific investigations and studies. The incumbent may help lead or coordinate specific monitoring efforts for the Surface Water Protection Program and act as a subject matter expert analyzing monitoring and environmental data to support DPR's continuous evaluation and mitigation efforts.
  

  

Specific responsibilities include:


* Conceives, proposes, plans, organizes, and directs complex surface water protection tasks, including primary and lead responsibility on scientific and technical evaluation of pesticide impacts to surface water.
* Independently conceives plans and implements complex studies to assess the spatial and temporal distributions of pesticide detections (and associated toxicity and aquatic macro\-invertebrate impairment) in surface water and sediment.
* Provides quality assurance and quality control of monitoring methods, analytical methods and monitoring data. Gathers, manages, assesses, and interprets monitoring and environmental data using a variety of tools and techniques including statistics, programming language (e.g., SQL, R, Python), geographic information systems (GIS), databases (e.g., MS Access), and/or other computer modeling in support of Surface Water's monitoring and mitigation efforts. Designs or defines needed equipment and instrumentation required for research, or develops new research methods to solve the most difficult surface water monitoring needs.
* Coordinates with state and federal pesticide and water quality agencies on scientific and regulatory projects of shared interest; consults with agencies, universities, growers, registrants, County Agricultural Commissioners, and stakeholders on complex monitoring and mitigation studies and other ecological health projects. Interacts with an interdisciplinary team of scientists.
* Writes reports, documents and technical publications, and makes oral presentations to governmental entities, professional societies, stakeholders, or pesticide user groups. Serves as technical advisor for programmatic or project needs.
* Performs critical review of data and proposed projects submitted by registrants, CDPR staff, and other agencies for scientific integrity and application to program objectives.

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.

Employee must have the ability to work in a high\-rise office environment and ability to use a computer monitor, mouse, and keyboard within an 8\-hr day. Employee must be capable of performing field studies and site visits that may involve hiking or climbing in areas with moderate slopes, unpaved surfaces, undeveloped roads, and other areas or structures where studies may be required. The employee must have the ability to conduct fieldwork for long hours under a variety of climatic conditions and, also, operate vehicles on public roadways or travel to remote areas. Travel that includes flying and/or driving on short notice and overnight stays will be required on trips to various field locations and community/board meetings. Employee may occasionally be required to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in order to minimize exposure to hazards. PPE include, but not limited to, gloves, safety glasses, ear plugs, hard hats, coveralls, and tight\-fitting respiratory protective equipment. When respiratory protective equipment is required, the employee must adhere to the fitting requirements stated in DPR’s respiratory protection policy.

Employees not residing in California are not eligible for telework. Regardless of telework eligibility, all employees may be required to report to the position’s designated headquarters location, as indicated on their duty statement, at their own expense.

The Measurement Assessment and Research Section (MARS) operates the Mobile Source Emissions Testing Facility in Sacramento, equipped with a heavy\-duty chassis dynamometer, advanced laboratory analyzers, Portable Emissions Measurement Systems (PEMS), and the Portable Emissions Acquisition System (PEAQS) to produce high\-quality, legally defensible emissions data. MARS’s mission is to support the development of heavy\-duty on\-road and off\-road vehicle regulations, strengthen emissions inventories, inform enforcement actions, advance the Clean Truck Check program, and drive research initiatives. As we continue to expand, we're looking for high\-performing professionals who are ready to lead, collaborate, innovate, and create impact. At Apex, you help shape what's next. All Apex positions are eligible for annual bonus opportunities, reinforcing our commitment to recognizing and rewarding meaningful contributions that drive our collective growth.

  

The Senior Technical Project Manager (PM) will lead and manage complex environmental investigation, remediation, and compliance projects involving chlorinated solvent impacts in soil, groundwater, sediment, soil vapor, and indoor air. The role requires strong technical leadership, client management, project delivery, staff development, and business development capabilities. Experience with large industrial, aerospace, manufacturing, military, and brownfield remediation programs is highly desirable.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project and Program Management**


* Manage large\-scale environmental remediation projects from proposal through closure.
* Develop project scopes, schedules, budgets, and health and safety plans.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of geologists, engineers, hydrogeologists, risk assessors, and environmental scientists.
* Monitor project financial performance, including revenue, profitability, utilization, and forecasting.
* Coordinate subcontractors, laboratories, drilling contractors, and remediation vendors.
* Maintain quality assurance and quality control standards.


**Technical Leadership**


* Serve as a technical lead for sites impacted by:

jobs.description:
Hims \& Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health \& wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.


Hims \& Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how\-it\-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent\-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers\-professionals.

**About the Role:**
-------------------


We're standing up a new in house video arm for paid social at Hims \& Hers, bringing high volume ad production in house so we can move faster and work across every category and both brands, Hims and Hers. The Creative Lead is a foundational hire in that build, not a role slotting into an existing team. **It's a hands on role based in Los Angeles**, with in person attendance on set on a varied schedule that follows the shoots, not a typical office week.


As Creative Lead, you're the creative engine of the pod, partnering with a marketing Creative Strategist who sets the initial vision, direction, and scripts for each concept. From there, it's on you to bring that vision to life visually, directing the shoot, shaping the look, and pulling in your Producer and editorial counterparts to get each concept shot, cut, and shipped at volume.


This is a hands on, wear many hats role. You're not waiting around for a finished brief, you're a genuine creative partner from the earliest idea, and you're comfortable adapting fast as priorities, categories, and brands shift.


You'll work across both Hims and Hers and each category, taking direction from Strategists on either line of business and executing it with your own creative craft. Producing at the volume this pod needs means staying hands on across the whole path from concept to a launched, high performing ad, not just owning one piece of it.

**You Will:**
-------------

* Partner with the marketing Creative Strategist from the earliest concept stage, translating their vision and scripts into a fully realized visual approach.
* Own the visual execution of the pod's output end to end, bringing the Strategist's scripts and concepts to life on screen, and contributing to copy or hooks when it helps.
* Be ready to direct shoots in person, giving real time notes to talent, crew, and production, and step behind the camera yourself (when needed) for lean, quick turnaround setups.
* Adjust lines on set when needed to keep the words and the visuals in sync. The scripts themselves come from the Strategist, but your read on what's working in the room matters.
* Shoot roughly 5 to 10 variants per concept to feed the post production iteration pipeline.
* Partner closely with the Producer on shoot planning, covering locations, talent, props, wardrobe, and shot lists.
* Collaborate with editorial and post production on every cut, giving clear, specific feedback to keep the work aligned with the original creative vision.
* Maintain a high bar for craft across the board, composition, typography, color, motion, clarity, and voice, even at high volume and speed.
* Translate what's winning in performance back into visual direction for future concepts and shoots, sharing insights with the Strategist to help shape future scripts.

**You Have:**
-------------

* 6 to 9 years of experience in art direction, video direction, or design, with copywriting or scripting as a secondary skill, and a portfolio spanning concept development and video first paid social or branded content, not just execution of others' briefs.
* Demonstrated experience developing visual treatments, along with giving clear creative direction to crews, talent, and editors.
* Hands on shooting experience, comfortable operating a camera yourself for lean shoots, not only directing a crew.
* Comfortable contributing to copy, hooks, or scripts when it's useful, even though scripts are typically owned by the Creative Strategist.
* Proven ability to concept and ship video first ads quickly in fast paced, high volume environments, balancing craft and business needs to deliver effective solutions with minimal guidance.
* Deep understanding of platform best practices for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap, and emerging short form formats.
* Comfort collaborating across functions with editorial, production, and other internal creative teams, including distributed or offshore teams, to protect creative vision through iteration.
* Comfort adapting your craft and creative point of view across multiple brands, categories, and audiences within a shared production system, rather than staying limited to a single brand.
* Strong creative instincts across both visual storytelling and voice, with proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and other relevant AI creative tools.
* Comfort working with performance data as a guide for creative decisions, not just craft instinct, exercising sound judgment in balancing creative risk against practical constraints driven by the business.
* A true go getter, comfortable wearing multiple hats and adapting fast as the needs of the business change, in a lean, fast moving in house team rather than an agency structure.

**Portfolio Requirements**


Please include a link to your portfolio or reel showing your role in concept development, storyboarding, visual direction, and scripting or copywriting where relevant, not just finished footage. Be clear about your specific contribution, whether concept, storyboard, director, DP, writer, or editor, on each project.

Working alongside experienced contaminated land and environmental professionals, you will contribute to a range of projects involving the investigation, assessment and management of contaminated sites.


You will have the opportunity to build your experience across field investigations, environmental sampling, data interpretation and technical reporting while learning from senior specialists with extensive experience in contaminated land assessment, remediation and environmental risk.


As your experience develops, you will be given increasing autonomy, direct client exposure and opportunities to manage smaller projects.


**What you'll be involved in**


Your responsibilities will include:


* Undertaking contaminated land and environmental site investigations
* Planning and participating in fieldwork, site inspections and environmental sampling programs
* Collecting, managing, analysing and interpreting environmental data
* Supporting preliminary and detailed site investigations
* Contributing to the assessment of contamination and environmental risks
* Assisting with remediation and site management projects
* Preparing clear, accurate and high\-quality technical reports and environmental advice
* Working with senior technical specialists on complex contaminated land projects
* Supporting projects involving a range of contaminants which may include hydrocarbons, heavy metals, PFAS, persistent organic pollutants and asbestos
* Liaising with laboratories, contractors, clients and other project stakeholders
* Preparing scopes of work and project costings under the guidance of senior team members
* Managing discrete or smaller projects as your capability and experience develop
* Monitoring project quality, risks, budgets and timelines
* Working collaboratively across multidisciplinary project teams
* Maintaining high standards of health, safety and environmental compliance in both field and office\-based activities


**About you**


We are looking for someone who is technically curious, practical and keen to build a career in contaminated land and environmental consulting.


You will ideally bring:


* 4 \- 7 years relevant experience.
* A tertiary qualification in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Geology, Chemistry or another relevant discipline
* Relevant experience in contaminated land, environmental consulting, site investigation or a related field
* Experience undertaking environmental fieldwork, site investigations or sampling
* An understanding of contaminated land assessment principles and environmental data
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good technical report writing skills and attention to detail
* The ability to confidently work in the field as well as contribute to technical and reporting activities in the office
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* A collaborative approach and willingness to learn from experienced technical specialists
* The ability to work independently while knowing when to seek technical guidance
* An understanding of project delivery including quality, safety, time and budget considerations
* A commitment to ongoing professional and technical development
